newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept aluminium fabricator output up 9.3% y/y.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept aluminium fabricator output up 9.3% y/y.

text.p: Production at seven major Japanese aluminium fabricators rose 9.3 percent in September from the same month last year to 133,555 tonnes, according to data compiled by the individual companies and released on Thursday.
Output for the half year to September 30 was up 2.6 percent year-on-year at 792,744 tonnes.
September output of flat-rolled products rose 9.1 percent year-on-year to 102,980 tonnes, while extruded products were up 10.2 percent at 30,575 tonnes.
For the April-September period, flat-rolled output was up 2.1 percent year-on-year at a record 620,836 tonnes, while extruded output was up 4.7 percent at 171,908 tonnes.
Can sheet showed particularly strong year-on-year growth of 26.2 percent in September to 36,189 tonnes, and 9.9 percent in the April-September half year to a record 231,441 tonnes.
Exports of flat-rolled products fell sharply by 26.1 percent in September to 14,629 tonnes and by 14.4 percent in the April-September half to 88,996 tonnes.
